content:
Hello,

I have noticed the following:

  1. The PDE roadmap does not seem to be finished. Can anyone tell me whether, and if so when, work on it will continue?
  2. It seems that it was intended to cover only elliptic and parabolic PDEs.
  3. Since I could not find anything on hyperbolic PDEs, I have been thinking of drawing up a roadmap myself. Essentially, I think one would need the following:
  4. Sobolev spaces Wk,pW^{k,p}Wk,p (p=2) on manifolds. In principle, k can also be a natural number. In Mathlib4, Bessel potential spaces have already been implemented, so there is no need to restrict ourselves to k∈Nk\in\mathbb{N}k∈N. However, the implementation is currently only for subsets of Rn\mathbb{R}^nRn.
  5. Definitions of linear symmetric hyperbolic systems.
  6. Definitions of quasilinear symmetric hyperbolic systems.
  7. Existence and uniqueness theorems for both types of systems.
  8. For quasilinear systems, I would follow Majda's proof.
  9. For linear systems, I am not sure whether I should use a discrete approximation or a mollifier and then essentially work with ODEs in Banach spaces.

Does anyone have any comments or advice?

Unless someone points their agents solely at the PDE roadmap then it will be filled in "randomly" as the tauceti workers pick up jobs. Making a new roadmap would be great, I don't know who made the original PDE roadmap but maybe @Kim Morrison knows since they may be a good person to also review the roadmap. To make a roadmap you should have a look at this and then ask your agent to help you write it.

ask your agent to help you write it

Technically, you can also write it yourself. Reviewers may appreciate it.
